content:
JVM Memory Areas:
- Heap: Objects and class instances. Shared across threads. GC-managed. Young Gen (Eden + Survivor S0/S1) + Old Gen + Metaspace.
- Stack: Thread-local. Stores frames for each method call (local variables, operand stack, reference to constant pool).
- Metaspace (Java 8+): Replaced PermGen. Stores class metadata. Native memory, auto-grows.
- Code Cache: JIT-compiled native code.
- PC Register: Thread-local program counter.

Garbage Collection:
- Minor GC: Eden → Survivor. Fast. Stop-the-world briefly.
- Major/Full GC: Old Gen. Slower. GC algorithms: G1 (default Java 9+), ZGC (sub-1ms pauses), Shenandoah.

List (ordered, allows duplicates):
- ArrayList: Dynamic array. O(1) get, O(n) insert/delete middle.
- LinkedList: Doubly linked. O(1) insert/delete at ends, O(n) get. Also implements Deque.

Set (no duplicates):
- HashSet: Hash table. O(1) add/contains. No order. Backed by HashMap.
- LinkedHashSet: Insertion-order maintained. O(1) operations.
- TreeSet: Red-black tree. O(log n). Sorted order. Implements NavigableSet.

Map (key-value):
- HashMap: O(1) get/put. Null keys/values. Not thread-safe. Java 8: treeifies buckets at 8 elements.
- LinkedHashMap: Insertion/access order. LRU cache implementation.
- TreeMap: Sorted keys. O(log n).
- ConcurrentHashMap: Thread-safe. Segment locking (Java 7) / CAS + synchronized (Java 8+).
